anomalies.observed: The schematic connects +5V to J1 pin 25 and J2 pin 27. Thus the two connectors do not pass +5V through on the same pin; instead, the +5V net spans different pin positions.
anomalies.expected: Both M-BUS connectors should carry +5V on pin 27, with matching pin-to-pin pass-through connectivity.

evidence.quote: J1: +5V at pin 25; J2: +5V at pin 27 (page 1).
J1 / J2 ... identical nets on both so the board can be stacked ... (page 1 of the supplied specification).
+5V net is also tied directly to J1/J2 pin 27 (page 1 of the supplied specification).

anomalies.impact: The M5Stack 5V supply is routed to mismatched bus contacts rather than passed through on the intended pin. This can leave the expected +5V contact unpowered and put +5V on an unintended contact, disrupting stacked-module power or compatibility.

parsed.summary: The schematic places +5V on J1 pin 25 but J2 pin 27, contradicting the specified matching +5V connection on pin 27. This breaks the intended M-BUS power pass-through and energizes a mismatched connector contact.
